error.gh_missing: GitHub CLI (gh) not found in PATH. Install it, then run: gh auth login

panel.empty: No open pull requests. All clear!
panel.empty_no_rules: No search rules configured. Add rules in Settings → Plugins → Octobar.
panel.truncated_note: …{count} more matches not shown (per-rule cap is 50)

excluded_repositories.description: Repository names to hide after fetching. * is supported; names without an owner match every organization. Examples: legacy-* · acme/private-*
excluded_repositories.label: Excluded repositories

hide_when_zero.description: Hide the bar widget when there are no open pull requests.
hide_when_zero.label: Hide when empty

ignored_authors.description: Logins whose reviews and comments are not reported. * is supported. Accounts GitHub marks as bots are always ignored.
ignored_authors.label: Ignored authors

notify.description: Notify approvals, change requests, comments and CI failures on your PRs, review requests and mentions.
notify.label: Desktop notifications

refresh_interval.description: How often pull requests are re-fetched.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)

rules.description: One GitHub search query fragment per entry; results are merged. Each is prefixed with 'is:pr is:open' (and 'archived:false' unless you set archived: yourself). Examples: author:@me · review-requested:@me org:acme · assignee:@me -repo:acme/legacy draft:false
rules.label: Search rules

tracked_branches.description: Local repository path → branch. The develop widget shows how many commits it is behind its GitHub origin. Example: ~/Projects/app → main
tracked_branches.label: Tracked branches
